ccd6ed15ff62334ccd653363f163dda1745b69c9.en: In the Correction Bureau report of December 2012, 21.9% and 29.6% are the estimated reoffending rates for "all offences".

bf9203b3065f530a94cdc9e5f702a34ab87010a3.ja: 答弁が挙げる21.9％と29.6％は、平成24年報告では「全ての犯罪」の再犯率です。
bf9203b3065f530a94cdc9e5f702a34ab87010a3.en: The 21.9% and 29.6% cited in the answer are, in the 2012 report, the reoffending rates for "all offences".

b0aae8d7f45b5d644a7480f4ef8dc1f77b308599.ja: 平成24年12月の報告書では、21.9％と29.6％は「全ての犯罪」の推定再犯率で、性犯罪の再犯では有意差がなく「効果を確認するまでには至らなかった」とされ、精度にも「一定の限界がある」と書かれています。
b0aae8d7f45b5d644a7480f4ef8dc1f77b308599.en: In the report of December 2012, 21.9% and 29.6% are the estimated reoffending rates for "all offences"; for sexual reoffending there was no significant difference and the report states that it "did not reach the point of confirming an effect", and also states that its precision "has certain limitations".
